title: [Installer] Preserve MSI file ownership with Smart Cabbing

proposed_comments.title: Preserve the existing install when a locked payload aborts upgrade

confidence.rationale: The pinned package leaves MajorUpgrade unscheduled, the new MSI File rows make locked payload installation fail, and the author reports a sustained-lock 1310/1603 path. The post-failure product state was not runtime-tested.

proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve the existing install when a locked payload aborts upgrade

**Severity:** `high`

**Affected code:** The new MSI `File` records in `generateAllFileComponents.ps1:134-139` and the `<MajorUpgrade>` in `Product.wxs:24`.

**Problem:** The new `WinUI3Apps` payload is installed through MSI `File` rows, but `Product.wxs` leaves `<MajorUpgrade>` on WiX's default early `RemoveExistingProducts` schedule. A sustained lock can then fail the new `InstallFiles` work after the old product has already been removed; rollback of the new install cannot restore that prior product.

**Why it matters:** An upgrade failure can leave PowerToys unavailable, or require a package-level retry, instead of preserving the previous version.

**Suggested change:** Keep the existing product installed until the replacement payload transaction succeeds, such as by selecting a rollback-safe upgrade schedule, or add a tested lock preflight/recovery path before removing it.
**Verification:** The PR reports that releasing an ordinary file lock allowed the upgrade to finish with MSI result `3010`, but its sustained-lock case reached `1310/1603` and only records an outer-package retry; cancellation/rollback recovery is explicitly unestablished. Add a failure-path check that verifies the old product remains registered and launchable after a locked-file failure for both per-user and per-machine upgrades.

proposed_comments.title: Make media generation safe to retry after an interrupted build

confidence.rationale: The exact generator consumes its only marker, the build files place restoration in the parent WiX post-build event, and a two-call check on a temporary Product.wxs reproduces the second-call exception.

proposed_comments.body:
### Make media generation safe to retry after an interrupted build

**Severity:** `medium`

**Affected code:** `Set-InstallerMedia` in `InstallerMedia.ps1:113-123`, the custom-actions project's pre-build generator, and the WiX project's post-build restore.

**Problem:** The generator replaces the only `<!--InstallerMedia-->` marker with media rows, consuming its retry anchor. If `PowerToysSetupCustomActionsVNext.vcxproj` fails after its pre-build event, the parent WiX project does not reach its post-build restore. The next pre-build then backs up the markerless `Product.wxs`, and the next `Set-InstallerMedia` call throws `Missing <!--InstallerMedia-->`.

**Why it matters:** A transient compiler or package failure can leave the installer source mutated so that a retry fails before the installer can be rebuilt.

**Suggested change:** Make the generated media block idempotent with a bounded generated section or separate output file, and ensure the original template remains recoverable when the referenced native project fails. Add an interrupted-build/retry regression.
**Verification:** Two calls to the exact `Set-InstallerMedia` implementation against a temporary `Product.wxs` removed the marker on the first call and threw `Missing <!--InstallerMedia-->` on the second. The PR-reported installer-media Pester suite passed 9/9 but does not exercise a failed native-project build followed by a retry.

proposed_comments.title: Back up PowerDisplay.wxs before harvesting it

confidence.rationale: The new PowerDisplay harvest mutates its WXS file, the native pre-build list omits its backup while the WiX restore expects one, and the pinned prefix-only replacement duplicates a one-file list on the second pass.

proposed_comments.body:
### Back up PowerDisplay.wxs before harvesting it

**Severity:** `medium`

**Affected code:** The new `PowerDisplay` `Generate-FileList` call in `generateAllFileComponents.ps1:300`, the native project's pre-build backup list, and the WiX project's post-build restore at line 55.

**Problem:** This harvest mutates `PowerDisplay.wxs`, but the custom-actions project's pre-build backup list omits that file even though the WiX project's post-build event tries to restore `PowerDisplay.wxs.bk`. The generated define therefore remains after the first build; `Generate-FileList` replaces only the define prefix and leaves the previous value, so a second one-file harvest produces `PowerDisplay.icoPowerDisplay.ico`.

**Why it matters:** A subsequent installer build can resolve a malformed asset path and fail, making local builds order-dependent.

**Suggested change:** Add `PowerDisplay.wxs` to the custom-actions project's pre-build backup list, or stop mutating the source file in place, and cover two consecutive harvests.
**Verification:** Running the exact define-replacement expression twice against the pinned `PowerDisplay.wxs` template produced `PowerDisplay.icoPowerDisplay.ico`; the PR-reported 9-test suite does not exercise repeated full generation.
